in_marathi.name: Navalkant
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Navel
in_marathi.long_meaning: Navalkant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Navalkant is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Naval' meaning navel and 'Kanta' meaning lord or protector. This name is believed to symbolize the divine presence within an individual and the protection of the divine being over the physical body.

vedic_reference.note: Navalkant is a Sanskrit name meaning 'New Gift' or 'New Treasure'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'navala' meaning 'new' and 'kanta' meaning 'gift' or 'treasure'. This name is not directly mentioned in any Vedic texts, but it is a beautiful and meaningful name that reflects the joy of receiving a new gift or treasure.
